one_liner: Pipedrive has a broad REST API (v1/v2) with OAuth 2.0 and API tokens, webhooks, OpenAPI specs, and an official MCP server; API access needs a paid seat or trial, but a developer sandbox is available.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow via oauth.pipedrive.com requires registering an app in Developer Hub (client_id/secret). Per-user API token sent in x-api-token header is also supported.
access_notes: Sources conflict. Pipedrive says every plan includes API access, and a developer sandbox exists. One source says the sandbox needs a paid plan, and another says there is no free plan, only a 14-day trial. Free path is therefore unclear. Trial or sandbox gives working credentials, and OAuth apps can be registered via Developer Hub.
blocker_notes: Minor friction: no permanent free plan (trial or sandbox needed for testing), and a daily token budget applies per account.

evidence.quote: The recommended authorization protocol for all public apps available in the Pipedrive Marketplace is the industry-standard OAuth 2.0 protocol
The API token must be provided in the `x-api-token` header for all requests
Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free.
No free plan. Free 14-day trial, no credit card, but signup requires a phone number
You'll need to be on a paid Pipedrive plan to access the sandbox for testing.
Pipedrive's API is a mature REST surface with two active versions (v1 and v2)
published OpenAPI 3 specs, official SDKs for Node.js and PHP, full webhook support
Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive, requires no coding, and works with real-time CRM data.
